name: Flood Ghoul

items.name: Consume Flesh
items.text:
Requirements The flood ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour

---
Effect The flood ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 2d6 healing Hit Points. It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

items.name: Death Echo
items.text:
Requirements The flood ghoul has damaged a creature with a melee attack

---
Effect The flood ghoul unleashes a wave of memories of its death by drowning. The targeted creature must succeed at a DC 15 Will save save or become Paralyzed for 1 round as they relive the flood ghoul's dying moments. A creature who successfully saves becomes temporarily immune for 1 hour.

items.name: Forbidden Cravings
items.text:
A creature can still eat and drink while sickened by this curse

Saving Throw DC 18 Will save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 void damage and the target is Sickened 1 until it consumes raw meat (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2

Stage 4 as stage 2 unless the target has consumed raw meat in the past 24 hours; then it takes 4d6 void damage and is Sickened 2 until it consumes raw meat

Stage 5 If the creature has eaten raw meat in the past 24 hours, it dies and rises as a ghoul; if not, it returns to stage 4.

items.name: Ghoul Whispers
items.text:
Requirements A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, or Unconscious creature is within the ghoul's reach

---
Effect The ghoul whispers dark thoughts and vile cravings into the creature's ears. The creature must attempt a save against the forbidden cravings curse.

items.name: Swift Leap
items.text: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

text:
Ghouls stalkers are ravenous undead who haunt graveyards and eat corpses.

---

Few creatures are more ubiquitous to sinister locations such as lonely graveyards and ruined crypts than the flesh-eating undead known as ghouls.
